annotations.title: Choose which tools a Nod may use

description: Replaces the tools ticked on one connection; [] unticks every one. A newly ticked name must be on the server's list now and marked read-only by the server; a tool your owner ticked in NodNod Studio may stay. Unticking never calls the server. Needs a confirmed owner. On only for accounts NodNod has opened it for; any other answers not_live.

connection_id.description: A connection id from list_connections or add_connection.
